description: Temurin TCK test stage. Triggers AQA_Test_Pipeline_JCK asynchronously with the archived JDK URL. Gated on ENABLE_TCK being true and RELEASE_TYPE being RELEASE or WEEKLY.

parameterGroups.name: Stage Selections
parameterGroups.description: Boolean flags that control which pipeline stages are enabled.

parameters.name: ENABLE_TCK
parameters.description: Run TCK tests. Only applies to Temurin variant builds on RELEASE or WEEKLY release types. Disabled by default — enable for official certification runs.
